openings.claim: Conservative bounds direct adjudication: equal predictions contribute zero; unadjudicated flagged rows with differing predictions contribute [-1,+1]; adjudications fix contributions. Replace provisional aggregate gains with total and slice bounds; decide only when remaining assignments support the outcome.
openings.discriminator: Against fixed slice-stratified sixteen-row review using corrected point totals, prevent unsupported threshold decisions, without promising more resolutions or fewer adjudications. Rival defeat requires demonstrated unsupported decisions or comparable certainty at greater cost; both unresolved establishes no advantage.
openings.probe: Run matched copies with identical four preselected withheld rows. Select accessible rows able to change total four or slice minus-two thresholds; break ties by record ID. Advance if total lower bound >=4 and every slice lower bound >=-2; reject if total upper bound <4 or any slice upper bound <-2. Otherwise continue within sixteen successful adjudications and seventy minutes, then report unresolved, affected slices and remaining bounds. Log identifiers, selection reasons, responses, unavailable attempts, allowance use and time; unavailable attempts consume no allowance. Freeze both reports before opening the sealed full-label key; compare decisions, residual uncertainty, adjudications and time.
openings.uncertainty: Unflagged supplied labels must remain fixed; disputed unflagged labels invalidate certification. Verify conservative bounds within seventy minutes or report unresolved. Withheld or numerous pivotal rows may prevent resolution. Annotator disagreement in the largest-improvement slice does not establish label error.

lineage.reason: Preserves contribution bounds, threshold rules, rival and defeat test, accounting, and uncertainty.

decision: Retain this bounded review probe using only supplied records and labels. Provisional gain six and slice loss two establish neither a supported advance/reject decision nor deployment readiness.
